title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

errors: No genuine error. In the NB the originally written hypothesis 'X ≱ Y' is superfluous: the argument uses only X ≠ Y (one of L=X, L=Y must fail), which Grothendieck himself recognized by adding 'X ≠ Y'.
The ⇐ direction of the criterion silently relies on Z° ≠ ∅ through part a). Grothendieck flags this dependence on p.90; it is a dependence, not a gap.

ideas.what: Axiomatic combinatorial description of a tame/stratified space via pieces with order, inclusion ≪, boundary ∂, shadow Omb, disjointness ∥ and open parts X°
ideas.modern_name: face posets / regular CW complexes / abstract stratified spaces; o-minimal cell decompositions
ideas.usually_credited_to: Björner (CW posets, 1984), Whitney–Thom–Mather (stratifications), van den Dries (o-minimal tame topology)
ideas.where_published: Tame topology programme only sketched in Esquisse d'un programme (§5) and Récoltes et Semailles; this axiomatics unpublished

ideas.what: Criterion: Y is in the open part of X iff the open parts of all pieces below Y lie in X°
ideas.modern_name: characterization of open stars / interiors in a face poset

ideas.what: Open parts of distinct pieces are disjoint (even mutually ∥)
ideas.modern_name: partition of a CW/stratified space into open cells

ideas.what: Supports S_A of unions of open parts, giving a sup-preserving map P(F~) → Σ_M (continued on p.92)
ideas.modern_name: reconstruction of the locale/lattice of closed/support sets from strata

missed.claim: The page is part of an unpublished, fully axiomatic 'analysis situs'. It is an intrinsic, point-free calculus of pieces, boundaries, shadows and disjointness, intended as a foundation for tame topology. The results proved on this page are routine; what is undocumented is the axiom system itself (≪, ∥, Omb, ∂, the divisibility axiom, L1–L3).
missed.quote: Soit Z ∈ X°∩Y° ⊂ Omb(X)∩Omb(Y) = Omb(L), Z ≪ L ... L ⊂ ∂X ... Z ∥ ∂X, Z ∥ Z, absurde!
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Comparing it with o-minimal cell decompositions, face-poset (exit-path) models of stratified spaces, and point-free topology might show whether Grothendieck's 'topologie modérée' foundation differs substantively from existing frameworks.

deep.surprise_reason: The local mathematics is elementary: an interior criterion and the disjointness of open strata. Interest lies only in its being part of the unpublished axiomatic tame-topology project of 1986.
transcription_corrections: 'Ouv(X) ∩ Ouv(Y) = Ouv(L)' should read 'Omb(X) ∩ Omb(Y) = Omb(L)' (ombre/shadow, as on p.90).
Hypothesis of the NB reads 'X ≱ Y' (not 'X ≯ Y'), with 'X ≠ Y' added above it.
The proof reads roughly: 'Or on n'aurait pas L=X, L=Y (puisque X≠Y), disons L≠X donc L⊂∂X. Z ∥ ∂X, Z ∥ Z, Donc Z ≪ ∂X, d'où ... absurde!'; 'X non comparables' is a misreading.
The marginal note 'Mieux, X° ∥ Y° cf. p. 95' is written vertically in the left margin.
'Ỹ' is probably the same accented Y (Y check) used on p.90.
End of page: 'Soit maintenant Φ ⊂ M ... partie de M, formée des pièces ≤, partie formée [multistricte] ... donc compatible ... OBS Φ = F~'. Here 'pièces' replaces 'parties'; the rest is uncertain.
